[i][b]Hochdeutsche-class Grand Opening [/b]

The United States of Oceanica and the [nation]Neue Republik[/nation] first public announcement of the Hochdeutsche-class nuclear supercarrier, marking the official public disclosure of this previously classified program, which remained so for nearly two decades. The inception of the project, known as the Hauptdeutsche-class Program, first took place in 2003 as an undercover collaborative project aiming to replace the older Nimitz-class supercarriers in action.

The years that followed saw improvements to the carriers Gen-IV nuclear power plant design and electric propulsion architecture from Navy engineering and ship design circles, along with designs for the advanced catapults and arresting gears, and hard defenses in the form of direct-energy weaponry and advanced command and control warfare architecture tailored to air wing operations. The prototype designs would undergo rigorous testing and construction of the USO and NR carriers would occur concurrently in different class field shipyards. With a full-load displacement of more than 125,000 tons, enhanced sortie generation capacities, and the ability to concurrently manage naval, air, space, cyber, and unmanned assets in the deployment. [/i]

fun fact of the day

only three clubs have taken part in all of the Guagolandese football championship editions, while five have never been relegated: Guago FC (very original name yes), Sportivo Sureño and Atlético San Pablo are the only ones to have taken part in all editions; while Guagópolis (again, very original name) and Marquesano Mariano have never been relegated but each missed a season due to administrative issues: Guagópolis had to call off its participation in the 1925-26 season, while Marquesano Mariano called off its 1937-38 season.

Guagópolis' missed season was when there was still no second tier so all good, but Marquesano Mariano had to re-work its way to the top and eventually ended up being promoted again for the 1939-40 season.

[i]Between Luscária and Lamandica
Land Transfer RP[/i]]

[b][March 18th, 2024]
[/b]
The Federation of Luscária has long noticed the growing pains of South Vespurias, the continent stands strong as a beacon of the West, as a beacon of civilization. But for far too long it has been subjected to the abuse, to the humiliation of forced occupation by foreigners. As a premier power of the continent we wish to make amends to such a situation.

Today we have been fortunate enough to find another power who shares a similar view to us, the Confederacy of Lamandica. For years now they have managed a small territory to the south of Luscária, but with this treaty we aim to transfer full sovereignty and administrative control of the South Vespurian territory to the Federation of Luscária, effective immediately upon ratification of this treaty.

We believe that such a transfer would serve the long-term stability and prosperity of Vespurias as a whole, and would align with the broader goal of regional decolonization. At the same time, we would not want Lamandica to suffer a loss as a result of this process. Lamandica has invested considerable effort and resources into developing the colony to its current state, and that contribution should be fairly recognized.

Therefore in exchange for the South Vespurian territory, the Federation of Luscaria is prepared to offer $25 billion, paid over a period of five years to the Confederacy of Lamandica.

[b]Signed,
[/b][i]Caudillo Manuel A. Torres
[/i][/spoiler]
[nation]Lamandica[/nation]

[spoiler=[b]Treaty For A Better Tomorrow[/b]
[i](Lamandicas Agreement To Luscárias Land Transfer Proposal)[/i]]

Horgingtonia, was a PR disaster for Prime Minister Calieno-Ruizs administration. A history of human rights abuses and gushing of money swept under the rug by the government has caused distrust amongst the public. After attacks by natives on cities like Puerto Encarnacion circulated across Lamandica, public outcry proved effective. Various nations have put in bids to absorb the region, but after months of negotiations. A deal has finally been reached.

In exchange for 25 billion dollars paid out over five years, the nearby nation of Horgingtonia, Luscária, will absorb the colony into its nation with the signing of The Treaty For A Better Tomorrow. This move reflects Lamandicas, and the worlds, growing understanding and discontentment with the premise of colonialism. The Lamandican government hopes this transaction can help spur relations between it and Luscária.

Much of Horgingtonias citizens have since fled back to mainland Lamandica, but many still remain. Until the land is officially ceded to Luscária, oil will still be sourced to Lamandica. Also, those still living in the region will continue to have Lamandican citizenship until 2030. This will only apply to those already living in Horgingtonia, as any newborns after the treaty will become Luscária citizens. After 2030, any Lamandican citizens remaining will either have to apply for Luscárian citizenship or move back to Lamandica. The Treaty For A Better Tomorrow will be signed between the two nations officially making the process legal.

Though Lamandicas presence in the region was turbulent and did not have many silver linings, it has allowed the confederacy to construct relations with others. [/spoiler]

[spoiler=2025/6/17][i]The following message is transmitted on behalf of the Lamandican Government. A mandatory curfew will be issued for the entire city of Taultion, starting at 21:00 EET. Lamandican National Guard officers will enforce this ordinance and arrest those in violation. All protests are to remain peaceful and disassemble before curfew. If anyone is caught disturbing the peace or blatantly violating the curfew, [b]force will be used[/b]. To repeat, a citywide curfew for Taultion will begin at 21:00 EET.[/i]

The Tax Day Riots have now been raging across Lamandica for over two weeks now, with no end in sight. Most schools across Lamandica have already any courses for the summer, leading to more young people to join in the protests. So far, the riots have killed 26 and injured 842, most of which were officers and National Guard members. Citizens have armed themselves with clubs, which they would use when officers try to detain them. Though mainly used to defend themselves, in one case, an officer was dragged out of his cruiser and beaten to death on Manaubs Asimc in Centre City Taultion. Because of this, curfews have been issued to disperse crowds and prevent more dangerous protests in the dark. Additionally, many police departments have started to use increased force on those disobeying and attacking the law. 
An estimated 4,500 buildings have been damaged or looted nationwide (most damaged buildings were petrol stations), with an estimated 550 being targets for arson, costing over 1.8 Billion Pelops. In Port Encrastle, a car dealership in downtown was looted, with popular videos showcasing protesters driving cars through a window of a showroom and taking them on joyrides, doing donuts at intersections, lighting them on fire, and using clubs to break off mirrors. Protests in Tanavaim province were slightly different from those in the rest of Lamandica. They featured less vandalism and were more about Lamandicas annexation of the region back in 2024. As the protests raged on, targets of vandalism shifted from petrol stations to police precincts, car dealerships, fast food restaurants (Triple B, Kyeurofoods, and Munyers were most targeted), government buildings, and big-box national chains. Local businesses, mom-and-pop shops, bodegas, and regional chains were mostly spared, as owners would frequently put locally owned signs on their windows. In Wichenvidence, three police precincts were burned down after Molotov cocktails were thrown through windows.
Besides police officers being short staffed, there were shortages of firefighters, with them and medics struggling to respond to calls. This lead to the death of an elderly woman in Cayvalliat, where medics were unable to respond to the womans cardiac arrest due to protesters blocking roads. After news of this tragedy spread, protests started to slow and became more sporadic, and protestors would begin to yield more to ambulances. However, despite less protests occurring, the public still was not satisfied with the government, and wanted something big to occur before they were done.

[b]2027/6/17: Cieliox & PKI Declare Bankruptcy[/b]

Two of Lamandicas largest petrol companies, Cieliox & PKI, announced bankruptcy on Thursday. The two corporations were heavy investors in Horgingtonia, and suffered major losses in assets when the region proved unsuccessful. With layoffs high and being hated by the general public, the pressure finally collapsed on the two, a major blow for the Lamandican Government which owns both companies.[/spoiler]
